messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for inference-runtime-prod — latency spike detected. Severity: Sev2. Trigger: 95th/50th latency > 85th percentile threshold for 5m. Pager: jamie. Runbook: inference-latency. Link: https://redwood/internal/pager/2160109876 :rotating_light:

jamie: I'm on it. hitting the bridge now, will grab quick metrics and traces. tagging @maria (SRE) for infra help.

maria (SRE): joining bridge. initial check: nodes showing sustained GPU utilization and a few pods in CrashLoopBackOff. collecting pod logs and dmesg.

jamie: observed slower token throughput from the runtime; some inference workers OOM'ing then restarting. adding a temporary throttling rule to the router to reduce burst traffic.

maria (SRE): run these collect commands and drop logs in /tmp on the bastion for evidence:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/inference-runtime -c runtime --since=30m | gzip > /tmp/runtime-logs-2160109876.gz
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide > /tmp/pods-2160109876.txt
# capture node dmesg for OOM/oom_kill hints
ssh node-12 'sudo dmesg | tail -n 200' > /tmp/node12-dmesg.txt
```

ops-coordinator: Noting customer impact — two customers (acme-corp, education-ai) reported timeouts between 11:02-11:17 UTC. CS alerted and initial templated comms sent. No PII leaked.

product-ops: Thank you. Can we estimate ETA to stable service? Customers asking for an update; need a short incident summary for comms.

jamie: Mitigation in progress: disabled non-essential background batch jobs, scaled up replica count for inference-runtime by +3, and applied a conservative rate-limit at the edge. latency trending down but still noisy. ETA ~ 20-30m for stable.

leo: Suggested immediate followups (short list):
- revert any risky config changes after stabilization
- capture heap/dump from one affected pod once stable
- create follow-up ticket for autoscaler tuning and memory caps

maria (SRE): Confirming OOM hints in node dmesg and python worker OOMKill logs in container stdout. Looks like memory pressure + occasional long requests that bloat KV cache. We should treat KV cache eviction as a contributing factor.

jamie: Agree. After stable, we should:
- snapshot timeline (11:00–11:30 UTC) with traces and logs
- reproduce load profile in staging to validate autoscaler behavior
- open remediation tickets and assign owners

ops-coordinator: Service is reporting stable at 11:28 UTC (95th latency back under SLO). Paging cleared. Marking this thread for post-incident follow-up. :white_check_mark:

product-ops: Let's schedule a postmortem meeting and a writeup. Proposed timeline: draft RCA within 48 hours, peer review within 72 hours, sign-off by ops lead within 96 hours. Who will own the writeup?

sara: I can own the RCA writeup (timeline + impact summary). jamie — can you collect the traces and raw evidence? maria — can you add infra contributing factors + logs? leo — please own remediation tickets and proposed fix plan.

jamie: Yep — I'll upload logs and a short timeline doc to the evidence folder (drive link will be posted).

leo: I'll create the remediation epic and smaller actionable issues (autoscaler tuning, KV-cache eviction policy, soft-limits on worker memory). Tentative ticket IDs: OPS-2184 (epic), OPS-2185 (autoscaler), OPS-2186 (kv-eviction). Assigning myself for now.

ops-coordinator: Postmortem meeting scheduled: 
- Calendar: 48h from now (2160260000) in #postmortems (virtual link attached in invite).
- Writeup owners: sara (writeup), jamie (evidence & timeline), maria (infra analysis), leo (remediation plan), product-ops (customer comms).

product-ops: For the impact summary — two paying customers experienced degraded responses; estimated token-loss < 0.1% of daily traffic. We'll prepare a short customer note once the RCA draft is ready. Keep legal in the loop if anything changes.

maria (SRE): Flag: need a small infra follow-up to add OOM alerting + node-level memory metrics to the dashboard. I'll open tickets and link in the RCA.

jamie: Uploading evidence now: https://drive.redwood/reports/incident-2160109876/evidence (logs, pod dumps, traces).

ops-coordinator: Action items captured (owners):
- OPS-2185 autoscaler tuning — owner: leo — due: 2 weeks
- OPS-2186 KV-cache eviction policy change — owner: leo — due: 2 weeks
- INF-342 add OOM/node memory alerts — owner: maria — due: 1 week
- RCA writeup draft — owner: sara — due: 48h
- Customer comms draft — owner: product-ops — wait for RCA, due: 72h

sara: I'll post the RCA draft as a Google doc and ping this thread. Please add any raw notes or inline comments.

leo: One more ask — include a brief cost/regression assessment for scaling changes (so finance knows expected spend bump).

ops-coordinator: Noting follow-up review steps: peer review by SRE + product-ops, legal check if needed, final sign-off by ops lead. Assigning this thread to track until the RCA is signed off.

jamie: Thanks everyone. Great coordination on the bridge. Will follow up in the draft with timeline and logs.

incident-bot: Incident cleared. Recording incident start=2160109876, end=2160109708, severity=Sev2, followup=RCA scheduled.
__notes: This file contains a single Slack thread: the root message (pager) and all follow-ups in chronological order. Messages are presented as a single continuous string with sender prefixes to match agents.md requirements.
